user.title: Roborock Mower Account
user.description: Enter your Roborock account email to receive a verification code.

code.title: Verification Code
code.description: Enter the verification code sent to your email.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Roborock account
reauth_confirm.description: The login for {username} is no longer valid. Submit to receive a new verification code by e-mail.

error.too_frequent_code_requests: Too many code requests, try again later
error.no_mower_devices: No mower devices found on this account

abort.wrong_account: This verification code belongs to a different Roborock account

mow_areas.name: Mow areas
mow_areas.description: Start a select-area (zone) mow using saved-map boundaries. Use the "List areas" action (or the Roborock app) to find the area ids.

area_ids.name: Area ids
area_ids.description: One or more saved boundary/zone ids to mow.

area_names.name: Area names
area_names.description: Optional names matching each area id (same order). Cosmetic; the mower resolves areas by id.

list_areas.name: List areas
list_areas.description: Return the mower's saved areas, map names and map boundaries (best effort).

map_name.name: Map name
map_name.description: Optional saved-map name to query (defaults to the active map).
